response.sql: WITH race_name_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS average_field_size FROM race_name_stats) SELECT AVG(s.average_points) AS average_points, AVG(s.field_size) AS average_field_size, AVG(s.field_size - o.average_field_size) AS average_field_size_above_overall FROM race_name_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.field_size > o.average_field_size;

assumptions.assumption: Field size is the number of matching driver standings rows for a race name, including rows with missing points.
